fact: The DGID says taxpayers can register online (immatriculation en ligne) through SENTAX, with membership requests validated by DGID services.
Senegal's Ministry of Finance order says foreign suppliers register remotely online with the tax authority and receive the NINEA tax identification number and an Etax login, effective 1 April 2024.
LoGRI says Senegal's tax directorate DGID uses an IT system, SIGUIL, to manage taxpayer data for property taxation, with a successor SIGUIL 2 deployed in ongoing property censuses.
